test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is true about the Sutta Pitaka?

options.text: It is Buddhist text that was written in Sri Lanka.
It deals with the conversation between the ruler of Magadha and the Buddha.
It is about the rules and regulations for those who joined the Buddhist monastic order.
It is the biography of the Buddha.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It deals with the conversation between the ruler of Magadha and the Buddha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sutta Pitaka is one of the three main sections of the Pali Canon, the scriptures of Theravada Buddhism.
 
• It contains more than 10,000 suttas (teachings) attributed to the Buddha or his close companions.
 
• The Sutta Pitaka is divided into five Nikayas: Digha Nikaya, Majjhima Nikaya, Samyutta Nikaya, Anguttara Nikaya, and Khuddaka Nikaya.
 
• It includes narratives and dialogues involving the Buddha and various individuals, including kings, disciples, and laypersons, which often illustrate moral and philosophical principles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pali Canon:**

 
 
• The Pali Canon is the standard collection of scriptures in the Theravada Buddhist tradition, preserved in the Pali language.
 
• It is divided into three "baskets" (Tipitaka): Vinaya Pitaka (disciplinary code), Sutta Pitaka (discourses), and Abhidhamma Pitaka (philosophical and doctrinal analysis).
 
 
 
• **Digha Nikaya:**
 
 
• One of the five Nikayas in the Sutta Pitaka, it contains long discourses (suttas), including important teachings and narratives.
 
• It includes notable suttas such as the Maha-parinibbana Sutta, which details the last days of the Buddha.
 
 
 
• **Majjhima Nikaya:**
 
 
• Another Nikaya in the Sutta Pitaka, comprising middle-length discourses (suttas), covering a variety of topics in Buddhist doctrine and practice.
 
• It is known for its practical and accessible teachings.
 
 
 
• **Vinaya Pitaka:**
 
 
• One of the three main divisions of the Pali Canon, it deals with the rules and regulations for the monastic community (Sangha).
 
• It is essential for the maintenance of discipline and order within the monastic community.
